$schema_note: Result summary transcribed from the CLAP-AD paper (Table 2: Bench2Drive-Speed results on 48 routes). Not raw simulator logs -- see docs/setup for reproducing with `--bench2drive-speed` and data/benchmark_routes/b2dspd_eval48.xml.

metrics.speed_adherence_all: Speed-Adherence (SA) score averaged over all routes, 0-100. Measures how closely realized speed tracks the requested speed.
metrics.speed_adherence_easy: SA on the Easy difficulty split.
metrics.speed_adherence_medium: SA on the Medium difficulty split.
metrics.speed_adherence_hard: SA on the Hard difficulty split.
metrics.delta_speed_adherence_all: SA change relative to the method's own backbone (null if not applicable).
metrics.delta_driving_score: DS change relative to the method's own backbone (null if not applicable).

methods.note: Baseline reference from the Bench2Drive-Speed paper; vendored TCP code under 3rd_party/Bench2Drive-Speed is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, not used by CLAP-AD.
